Vancouver's 2026 commercial renovation market runs $50K to $1.5M per project depending on type and scope. Office refreshes start at $50K; full restaurant builds and medical clinic fit-outs routinely reach $750K to $1.2M. Reno Stars has completed dental clinic, retail and office conversion projects across Burnaby, Richmond and Vancouver — here is what those projects actually cost.

What Does Commercial Renovation Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Commercial renovation costs in Metro Vancouver depend on the building type, scope of work and BC Building Code classification. Office refreshes — paint, flooring, lighting, partitions — start at $50K. Full restaurant builds and medical clinic fit-outs routinely reach $750K to $1.2M. The table below reflects Reno Stars' 2025–2026 project data.

Renovation TypeCost per sq ftTypical Total (2026)
Office refresh (paint, flooring, lighting)$80–$160/sq ft$50K–$200K
Retail build-out$100–$300/sq ft$100K–$500K
Restaurant (full kitchen + dining)$200–$500/sq ft$300K–$1.2M

Beauty salon / spa$150–$350/sq ft$150K–$500K

What Vancouver Business Owners Need to Budget For

Beyond the base fit-out cost, four items routinely add $10K to $80K each to a commercial project in Vancouver. Strata buildings (high-rise office) add 10–20% due to work-hour limits, freight elevator bookings and building protection requirements. Heritage buildings add 10–25% for facade work due to heritage register constraints. Buildings pre-1990 may require asbestos remediation ($10K–$80K depending on square footage). HVAC zoning for restaurants and medical clinics adds $30K–$80K. Fire-suppression upgrades triggered by partial use-change permits add $25K–$80K.

BC Building Code classification is the single most important budget variable. Class 3 buildings (large/complex commercial) require sealed architectural and engineering drawings, BC Building Code reference and fire-alarm system design. Class 9 buildings follow a simpler path. Permit complexity (Class 3 vs. 9) alone can add $15K–$50K in professional fees. Reno Stars reviews building classification at every free on-site consultation.

Vancouver Restaurant Renovation Costs

Vancouver restaurant renovation costs start at $300K for a basic fast-casual fit-out and reach $1.2M for a full-service restaurant. Beyond the general commercial items above, restaurant projects carry five cost categories that do not appear in office or retail builds.

Restaurant Item2026 Cost Range
Commercial exhaust hood (Type I) + rooftop curb$35K–$90K
Make-up air unit$15K–$35K
Grease trap (1,000-lb indoor type)$8K–$18K installed
Walk-in cooler (8x10)$25K–$45K
Health-authority-compliant prep area + three-compartment sink$8K–$20K
Liquor licence renovation$5K–$15K
Patio + outdoor service area$20K–$80K

All restaurant work requires VCH FoodSafe compliance; grease trap installation and a BC Plumbing Code– and NFPA 96–compliant commercial exhaust hood are mandatory. Reno Stars has completed restaurant projects in Richmond and Burnaby; all included public-health final inspection as part of the permit package.

Medical and Dental Clinic Renovation Costs

Vancouver medical and dental clinic fit-out costs start at $400K for a basic single-operatory dental clinic and reach $1.5M for a multi-discipline medical plaza. Medical clinic costs above standard commercial fit-out include negative pressure rooms for aerosol-generating procedures ($15K–$40K each), medical gas systems ($20K–$60K per floor), and BC Building Code 2018 accessibility upgrades ($8K–$30K minimum). Reno Stars completed the dental clinic renovation in Burnaby — delivered on time and on budget, with zero public-health inspection findings.

How Long Does a Commercial Renovation Take in Vancouver?

Vancouver commercial renovation timelines in 2026 range from 8 weeks for a basic office refresh to 52 weeks for a full restaurant or multi-operatory clinic build-out. Design and permitting adds 4–12 weeks upfront for Class 9 buildings and 8–24 weeks for Class 3 buildings. BC Building Code requirements for assembly occupancies trigger additional occupancy-permit timelines. Reno Stars provides a detailed project schedule at the free consultation stage.

Commercial Renovation Permits in Vancouver

Commercial renovation permits in Metro Vancouver in 2026 require a building permit for any work that alters structural elements, changes the occupancy type or exceeds $5K in trade work. Permits cost $2,000–$15,000 depending on project value and classification. Heritage alteration permits add 4–8 weeks. Tenant improvement permits in strata buildings require Strata Corporation approval before the City will issue a building permit — the most common cause of delay in strata office and retail renovations. Reno Stars manages the full permit process including Strata approval, heritage review and VCH submission.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average cost per square foot for a commercial renovation in Vancouver in 2026?

Vancouver commercial renovation costs in 2026 range from $80 to $700 per square foot depending on building type. Office refreshes run $80–$160/sq ft, retail build-outs $100–$300/sq ft, restaurants $200–$500/sq ft and medical or dental clinics $300–$700/sq ft. Total project costs start at $50K for a basic office refresh and reach $1.5M for a full medical clinic fit-out.

Does a commercial renovation require a building permit in Vancouver?

Yes. Any commercial renovation that alters structure, changes occupancy type or involves more than $5,000 in electrical, plumbing or gas work requires a Vancouver building permit. Heritage buildings also require a heritage alteration permit, which adds 4–8 weeks. Tenant improvements in strata buildings require Strata Corporation approval before the City issues a permit.

How long does a restaurant renovation take in Vancouver?

A Vancouver restaurant renovation takes 12–52 weeks from design through occupancy permit, depending on scope. A basic fast-casual fit-out takes 12–16 weeks. A full-service restaurant with a new commercial kitchen takes 24–36 weeks. All restaurant projects in Vancouver require VCH FoodSafe final inspection before opening.

温哥华企业主需要预算哪些项目

常见问题

2026年温哥华商业装修每平方英尺的平均费用是多少？

2026年温哥华商业装修费用根据建筑类型从每平方英尺$80到$700不等。办公室翻新每平方英尺$80-$160，零售装修$100-$300，餐厅$200-$500，医疗或牙科诊所$300-$700。

温哥华商业装修需要建筑许可吗？

是的。任何改变结构、改变占用类型或涉及超过$5,000电气、管道或气体工程的商业装修都需要温哥华建筑许可。历史建筑还需要遗产改造许可，增加4-8周。

温哥华餐厅装修需要多长时间？

温哥华餐厅装修从设计到占用许可需要12-52周，取决于范围。基本快餐店装修需要12-16周。完整服务餐厅需要24-36周。所有餐厅项目在开业前都需要VCH FoodSafe最终检查。
